description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order No. 08 of 2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a Revenue Protection Order and detailed amendments to customs duties and tariff classifications under the Customs Ordinance. It involves regulatory changes to import duties, concessions, and exemptions, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of his statutory powers to make regulatory changes. The content is predominantly about legal frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel or structure.
